paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption: Mean absolute values before and after gating. The baseline and post-gating values are similar.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The provided figure, titled “Hidden State Mean,” illustrates the mean absolute values of hidden states across layers in a neural network model, comparing values before and after a gating mechanism, alongside a baseline. The x-axis represents the “Layer,” ranging from 0 to approximately 22, with labeled tick marks at intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). The y-axis represents “Abs Mean,” ranging from 0 to 4, with labeled tick marks at intervals of 1 (0, 1, 2, 3, 4). The units on the y-axis are unspecified, but the values represent mean absolute values.

Three distinct lines are plotted:

1.  **Blue dashed line (“hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71”)**: This line starts at approximately 0.0 on layer 0, fluctuates slightly above zero with minor peaks and troughs up to layer 20, reaching a value of approximately 0.8. After layer 20, it exhibits a steep upward trend, rising sharply to approximately 4.2 by layer 22.
2.  **Orange dotted line (“hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05”)**: This line remains consistently near zero throughout the entire range, starting at approximately 0.0 on layer 0 and ending at approximately 0.05 on layer 22. It shows minimal variation.
3.  **Green solid line (“hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04”)**: This line also remains consistently near zero, starting at approximately 0.0 on layer 0 and ending at approximately 0.04 on layer 22. It shows minimal variation and remains very close to the orange dotted line.

The caption notes that the baseline and post-gating values are similar, which is visually consistent with the near-identical, flat trajectories of the orange dotted and green solid lines. The blue dashed line, representing the pre-gating state, shows a significantly larger and more variable mean absolute value compared to the other two lines.
model_annotations.Chinese: This line chart, titled "Hidden State Mean," displays the mean absolute values of hidden states across different layers in a model, comparing three conditions: the hidden state mean before the gate (blue dashed line), the hidden state mean after the gate (orange dotted line), and the hidden state mean of a baseline (green solid line). The x-axis, labeled "Layer," uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 4, with tick marks at intervals of 1. The blue dashed line, representing the hidden state mean before the gate, starts at approximately 0.05, fluctuates slightly between 0.05 and 0.71, and then rises sharply after layer 20, reaching a value of approximately 4.3. The orange dotted line, representing the hidden state mean after the gate, remains very low, hovering near 0.05 throughout the entire range. The green solid line, representing the baseline, stays consistently near 0.04 across all layers.
model_annotations.English: This line plot, titled "Hidden State Mean," illustrates the mean absolute values of hidden states across different layers of a model, comparing the state before gating, after gating, and a baseline. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," ranges from 0 to 20 and is plotted on a linear scale with tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," ranges from 0 to 4 and is also on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 1. The plot contains three lines: a blue dashed line with circular markers representing the "hidden state mean before gate," which starts at approximately 0.05, remains relatively low and fluctuates between roughly 0.1 and 0.5 until layer 20, then sharply increases to about 4.3; an orange dotted line with circular markers for the "hidden state mean after gate," which stays consistently near 0.05 across all layers; and a green solid line with circular markers for the "hidden state mean of baseline," which remains near 0.04 across all layers. The caption notes that the baseline and post-gating values are similar, which is visually supported by the near-identical, low, flat trajectories of the orange and green lines.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt den Mittelwert der absoluten Werte von Hidden States an verschiedenen Layer-Positionen, verglichen zwischen dem Zustand vor dem Gate, dem Zustand nach dem Gate und einem Baseline-Wert. Die x-Achse ist beschriftet mit „Layer“ und verläuft linear von 0 bis etwa 22, mit regelmäßigen Tick-Beschriftungen alle 5 Einheiten ohne explizite Einheitenangabe. Die y-Achse ist beschriftet mit „Abs Mean“ und verläuft linear von 0 bis 4, mit regelmäßigen Tick-Beschriftungen alle 1 Einheit ohne explizite Einheitenangabe. Die blaue gestrichelte Linie, die „hidden state mean before gate“ repräsentiert, beginnt bei etwa 0.03 bei Layer 0 und steigt bis zu etwa 4.3 bei Layer 22; sie zeigt dabei einen allgemeinen Anstieg mit mehreren kleinen Spitzen und Rückgängen, z. B. einen Anstieg von etwa 0.2 bei Layer 5 auf etwa 0.3 bei Layer 10 und einen weiteren Anstieg von etwa 0.3 bei Layer 15 auf etwa 0.8 bei Layer 20, bevor sie steil auf etwa 4.3 ansteigt. Die orangefarbene gestrichelte Linie, die „hidden state mean after gate“ repräsentiert, beginnt bei etwa 0.01 bei Layer 0 und bleibt über den gesamten Bereich nahezu konstant bei etwa 0.05, mit leichten Schwankungen zwischen etwa 0.03 und 0.06. Die grüne durchgezogene Linie, die „hidden state mean of baseline“ repräsentiert, beginnt bei etwa 0.0 bei Layer 0 und steigt langsam und flach bis etwa 0.04 bei Layer 22, bleibt dabei nahezu konstant bei etwa 0.02 bis 0.03 und zeigt keine signifikanten Spitzen oder Rückgänge.
